name: Daily Email Notification
description: Summarizes daily inbox emails using local LLM (Ollama) and sends notifications via Telegram or ntfy.

source.n8nName: Daily IMAP Email Summary to Telegram (Local Ollama)

blockers.detail: yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND waits for the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1) to be published

setup: "Send ntfy Summary": yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND comes from the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1), which is not published yet; this step fails until it ships, then the template promotes on the next catalog refresh.
Setup value yourOllamaModel: Your Ollama Model. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value yourTelegramChatId: Your Telegram Chat Id. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value yourNtfyTopic: Your Ntfy Topic. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate daily-email-notification.

hints: "Fetch Gmail via IMAP" (executeCommand): Host shell commands are not run in Transform; use an agent sandbox shell if you need the original command.

"Fetch Gmail via IMAP": original command was "python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime
import email
import imaplib
import json
import re
from collections import OrderedDict
from email.header import decode_header
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datet" - run equivalent logic in an agent sandbox shell (not SSH).
"Send ntfy Summary" sends its raw body with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
